blocks.rationale: Create one joint package narrowly targeted to the three trigger failures. The baggage calculator applies the source’s carry-on classification, ordinal checked-bag charges, complimentary allowances, and higher-of excess-fee rule; it also covers the history airline case. The tax helper independently verifies both the asserted subsection and the computed bracket amount, avoiding interference with the unrelated SARA history case.

reads.question: Extract the current passenger's item measurements and the complete applicable baggage allowance and fee schedule from the current facts and airline source.
reads.source_locator: current view source_text, facts, and question

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Classify only items satisfying the current source's item-count and dimension requirements as free personal or carry-on items.

origin.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.

source_obligations.statement: Use the applicable route, cabin, and checked-bag ordinal to obtain each base checked-bag fee, including any complimentary entitlement.

origin.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

source_obligations.statement: Calculate checked-bag size as the sum of its outside length, width, and height.

origin.quote: More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: When a checked bag is both overweight and oversize, add only the higher of those two excess charges to its checked-bag fee.

source_provenance.quote: Your personal item like a purse or small handbag must fit under the seat in front of you. Dimensions should not exceed 18 x 14 x 8 inches (45 x 35 x 20 cm).
The total size of your carry-on, including the handles and wheels, cannot exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) and must fit in the sizer at the airport.

For all regions, except to / from Australia or New Zealand, your checked bag allowance is:
* Dimension: 62 in / 158 cm
* Weight: 50 lbs / 23 kgs
* For First / Business, weight is 70 lbs / 32 kgs for complimentary bags and 50 lbs / 23 kgs for excess charged bags
More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.
